Statistical Report - Second Level Model
Group analysis: faces Implement the :term:`General Linear Model` for multiple subject :term:`fMRI` data.

Description

Data were analyzed using Nilearn (version= 0.13.1; RRID:SCR_001362).

At the group level, a mass univariate analysis was performed with a linear regression at each voxel of the brain.

Input images were smoothed with gaussian kernel (full-width at half maximum=6 mm).

The following contrasts were computed :

  • intercept
